title: DOT Academy — Life in the digital age
description: An Academy for life in the digital age: attention, lived experience, and development toward Love. Explore DOT’s hypothesis of consciousness beyond any particular Reality Frame.
heading: An Academy for life
in the digital age.
introduction: Begin with your lived experience. Examine the beliefs shaping your perception, take responsibility for your choices, and develop toward Love: greater coherence, less fear, and care for others.

hypothesis.label: DOT · Working hypothesis
hypothesis.heading: Consciousness beyond the frame.
hypothesis.body: DOT proposes that your conscious life exists independently of any particular Reality Frame—the rule-bound environment through which you experience a world. Digital here means informational, not electronic.

start.label: Start with your experience

publication.heading: Begin with Book One.
publication.body: The book, concept map, and open questions are public now. Academy responses, experiments, and essays are still in development. Book One remains a fixed, citable edition.
